accueil.titre: Find your next home in Brussels
accueil.sousTitre: Flats, houses and commercial premises for sale and to rent

visite.intro: No more waiting for the agency to call back: you see the agent's free slots and book yours.

choisir.texte: Photos, description, map of the area: everything is on the property page.

reserver.texte: Free slots are shown for the next 60 days. A slot already taken is no longer offered.

visiter.texte: You receive an e-mail, and the exact address of the property once the viewing is confirmed.

standard.texte: You send your request, the agent confirms it.

premium.texte: Secure payment by card or Bancontact, viewing confirmed at once. Refunded if you cancel up to 24 h before.

compte.texte: Keep your favourites, write to the agents and follow your viewings.

biens.erreur: Properties cannot be loaded right now.

reassurance.adresse: Address given once the viewing is confirmed

bien.adresseApres: The exact address is shared once a visit is booked.
bien.plusDeVisite: This property is no longer open for visits.
bien.introuvable: This property does not exist or is no longer available.

auth.connexionSousTitre: Access your favourites, messages and visits.
auth.inscriptionSousTitre: Free — book visits online for our properties.
auth.donnees: Your data is only used to run your account. The details are on the page
auth.motDePasseRegles: At least 8 characters, with a lower-case letter, an upper-case letter and a digit. A password found in a known data breach is refused.
auth.codeSousTitre: A six-digit code has just been sent to {{email}}. It is valid for ten minutes.
auth.activationRenvoyee: If this address belongs to an account that is not activated yet, a new link has just been sent.
auth.oubliSousTitre: Enter your e-mail address: you will receive a link to choose a new password.
auth.oubliEnvoye: If this address belongs to an account, an e-mail has just been sent. The link is valid for thirty minutes.
auth.reinitialisationFaite: Your password has been changed and all your sessions have been closed. You can log in.
auth.activationFaite: Your address is confirmed: your account is active and you are logged in.
auth.activationAide: The link may have been used already, or expired. Try to log in: a new link can be sent again.
auth.verifiezTexte: An e-mail has just been sent to {{email}}. Open the link it contains to activate your account; it is valid for 24 hours.
auth.verifiezDemo: Demonstration site: e-mails are not sent to your address, they arrive in the demonstration mailbox.
auth.cguRequises: The terms and conditions must be accepted.
auth.consentement: I agree to receive information about new properties and agency news. This choice can be changed at any time in the profile.

profil.desinscriptionExplication: In line with the GDPR, your personal data will be anonymised and your favourites deleted. The history of your visits and payments is kept without identity (accounting obligations).
profil.confirmerDesinscription: Confirm the deletion of your account? This cannot be undone.
profil.doubleFacteurExplication: At each login, a code sent by e-mail will be required in addition to the password.
profil.doubleFacteurImpose: Mandatory for your role: a code sent by e-mail is required at each login.
profil.communicationsExplication: Receive information about new properties and news. Can be withdrawn at any time.
profil.mesDonneesExplication: Receive a copy of all the data the site holds about you: account, favourites, viewings, payments, messages and history (right to data portability, GDPR).

rdv.reserveAuxMembres: Only members can book a visit.
rdv.legende: Daytime slots are free. Premium slots, in the evening and at the weekend, cost {{prix}}.
rdv.aucunCreneau: No time slot is free in the next two weeks.
rdv.motifExemple: For example: second visit with my architect
rdv.explicationStandard: Your request is sent to the agent, who confirms it or suggests another time.
rdv.explicationPremium: A premium slot is confirmed as soon as it is paid. You are refunded if you cancel up to 24 hours before the viewing.
rdv.paiementRefuse: The payment was declined. Nothing has been charged: you can try again with another card.
rdv.simulation: Demo mode: no real payment. Accepted card: 4242 4242 4242 4242 — declined card: 4000 0000 0000 0002.
rdv.demandeEnvoyee: Your request has been sent to {{agent}}. You will be notified once it is confirmed.
rdv.confirme: Your visit is confirmed. {{agent}} will meet you on site.
rdv.confirmerAnnulationPayee: Cancel this visit? The premium slot payment will be refunded.
rdv.annulationSansRemboursement: no longer possible: less than 24 h before the viewing, the slot is not refunded
rdv.confirmerAnnulationTardive: Cancel this viewing? Less than 24 hours before the viewing, the premium slot is not refunded.

favori.vide: You have no favourite yet. Add a property with the heart on its page.

message.reserve: Only members and agents can use messaging.
message.aucune: No conversation yet. Write to an agent from a property page.
message.aucuneAgent: No member has written to you yet.
message.premier: No message yet. Write the first one.

annonce.confirmerArchivage: Archive “{{titre}}”? The listing will leave the public site and stay in your history.
annonce.explicationCreation: The listing is created offline. Then add at least one photo to be able to publish it.
annonce.explicationAdresse: The exact address is never shown publicly: the member receives it once the visit is confirmed.
annonce.explicationCarte: Click on the map where the property is to fill in its position.
annonce.explicationStatut: Publishing requires at least one photo. A property cannot be sold, rented or taken offline while visits are planned.
annonce.corriger: Some fields need to be corrected.
annonce.sansPhoto: This listing has no photo yet: it cannot be published.
annonce.photoConsigne: JPEG or PNG, 5 MB at most, at least 400 pixels on the longest side. The photo is resized and its metadata is removed.
annonce.photoFormat: Only JPEG and PNG photos are accepted.
annonce.photoTropLourde: A photo weighs 5 MB at most.
annonce.pebAide: The EPC energy rating is mandatory in every property advertisement.

blog.sousTitre: Advice, market and property news in Brussels and Belgium.
blog.vide: No article in this category yet.
blog.introuvable: This article does not exist or is no longer published.

compte.recherche: Last name, first name or e-mail
compte.confirmerDesactivation: Deactivate the account of {{nom}}? This person will no longer be able to log in; their history is kept.
compte.explicationAgent: Public sign-up only creates members. The staff number is assigned automatically; the agent will change the temporary password from their profile.

journal.explication: Every sensitive action is logged: who, what, when and from which address. The log can be read; it cannot be changed.

cle.explication: An API key gives access to the open datasets (anonymised listings and statistics). It is sent in the X-API-Key header, is limited to 60 calls per minute and can be revoked at any time.
cle.avertissement: Copy this key now: it will never be shown again. Only its fingerprint is kept.
cle.confirmerRevocation: Revoke the key “{{libelle}}”? This takes effect immediately and is permanent.

traduction.explication: The texts below are those of the public site, in its three languages. A change is visible as soon as it is saved.
traduction.recherche: Search a key or a text

article.consigne: Plain text: line breaks are kept, no tag is interpreted. A new article is a draft, hidden from the public until it is published.

signalement.explication: Content reported by users. Removing wipes the message, takes the listing offline or archives the article; keeping leaves it in place. Every decision is motivated, final and logged.

parametre.explication: Agency identity shown on the site and languages offered to visitors. Payment and e-mail keys are not set here: they stay on the server.
parametre.languesExplication: A disabled language disappears from the selector; French, the language of the reference texts, always stays active.

erreur.creneau-indisponible: This slot has just been booked. Please choose another one.
erreur.bien-indisponible: This property is no longer available.
erreur.paiement-indisponible: The payment service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
erreur.conflit-etat: This action is no longer possible for this visit.
erreur.interdit: You are not allowed to perform this action.
erreur.fichier-trop-volumineux: A photo weighs 5 MB at most.
erreur.quota-depasse: Too many calls: try again in a minute.
erreur.trop-de-tentatives: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
erreur.lien-invalide: This link or code is no longer valid.
erreur.compte-non-active: Confirm your e-mail address first: open the link received when you signed up.

credits.intro: The photos of the demonstration listings come from Wikimedia Commons and are published under a free licence. None of them shows a property actually offered for sale by ImmoConnect.
credits.modifications: Each photo has been cropped and resized; it remains under the licence of the original, shown next to its author.

signalement.merci: Thank you, your report will be reviewed by the site team.
